 MALAYSIANS have been suffering from recurring transboundary haze for years. It pollutes the air that we breathe, affects public health, reduces visibility, limits outdoor activities and hurts tourism.
 The people want the government to do something concrete about the haze instead of asking them to wait for the transition to the Northeast Monsoon, which is expected to ease the situation.
